fields.title: Article / latest-headline record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (failed URLs are not written to the dataset -- they are reported in the ERRORS record of the run's key-value store). Article-mode records (S1-html, articleBody pulled from HTML div.articleBodyText blocks since ld+json has no articleBody) carry headline/articleBody-style fields; latest-mode records (S2-rss, sitewide /rss.xml) carry title/link-style fields.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact input value (URL, or 'latest') that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record (e.g. S1-html, S2-rss).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_paywalled.title: Paywalled
_paywalled.description: Honest per-article flag: true only when upstream marked the article isAccessibleForFree=false AND the scraped body looks like a short stub (<600 chars). Never fabricated -- in recon, every sampled article (including flagship columnists) was isAccessibleForFree=true with a full-length body, so this has not been observed to fire; see CRAWLING_METHOD.md.

headline.title: Headline
headline.description: Article headline, from the NewsArticle ld+json block.

articleBody.title: Article body
articleBody.description:
Full article text, joined from

tags inside every div.articleBodyText block on the page (Telegraph splits the body across multiple sibling blocks, interleaved with inline images).

author.title: Author
author.description: Comma-joined byline name(s), extracted from the ld+json author Person array.

publisher.title: Publisher
publisher.description: Publisher name from the ld+json publisher object.

section.title: Section
section.description: Best-effort section name derived from the first URL path segment (e.g. "news", "business", "sport") -- ld+json's own articleSection field is always empty on this site, so this is a fallback, not load-bearing.

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Comma-separated tag string from the ld+json keywords field, passed through verbatim.

image.title: Image
image.description: Lead image object(s) from ld+json (article mode) or RSS <enclosure url> (latest mode).

isAccessibleForFree.title: Accessible for free
isAccessibleForFree.description: Upstream paywall metering flag from ld+json, passed through as-is.

title.title: Title
title.description: Headline text of a latest-mode RSS item.

link.title: Link
link.description: Article URL from the RSS item.

description.title: Description
description.description: Short teaser text from the RSS item (latest mode only).

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: List of taxonomy-style <category> values from the RSS item (e.g. "topics:places/middle-east", "structure:opinion").

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across both article and latest-headline records.
